reviewsHeader.heading: Don’t take our word for it?

reviews.text: Simon is truly helpful and friendly. He is very knowledgeable about opportunities and understanding prospective roles based on skills and experience. There was great communication keeping in touch throughout and aiding onboarding. A very positive experience.
reviews.name: Nick Grech-Cini

reviews.text: It took less than a week for Simon Girling to find the right person to fill this important role, representing civil engineering contractors across the South West. His professionalism, energy and lively personality made this exercise an absolute pleasure. And he delivered 100%.
reviews.name: Paul Santer – CECA Regional Director

reviews.text: Simon was incredibly helpful, he worked very hard with job opportunities, extremely friendly. A great all round experience, couldn’t have asked for more. Great friendly guy. Thank you so much for the positive experience
reviews.name: Donna Kass

reviews.text: Truly positive experience, with great communication. Simon has kept my best interests in mind to find the right role for me. Highly professional and skilled throughout the whole process, providing stress-free opportunities. Thank you Simon and team
reviews.name: Oliver Bunn

reviews.text: During my tenure with Girling Jones I have found them to be most professional and supportive of both their agents and clients. They communicate in a friendly and inclusive manner, regularly keeping us updated of all circumstances regarding our work placements. Highly recommended should you require their services as either agent or client.
reviews.name: Tim Dix

reviews.text: Worked with the team at Girling Jones now for over a year. Simon was my contact there and continued to go out of his way, over and above what you would think… always did what was promised. Perfect.
reviews.name: Jeremy Harker

reviews.text: My experience with the business at all times has been of the highest quality and very professional. They respond to requests in a very timely manner and the level of detail on all candidates is exceptional. I am currently using the business to recruit and am confident that I will get the quality of candidate that the business requires to grow.
reviews.name: Andrew Murphy

reviews.text: I have worked with Girling Jones as both a client and more recently as a candidate. I have always found them to be professional and proactive in the way they go about recruiting. Certainly one of the better recruitment agencies in the South West and highly recommended
reviews.name: Julian Holmes

reviews.text: This agency are amazing, professional at the same time as been very friendly. I honestly can’t speak highly enough of this company, also I would recommend in a heart beat. Thank you guys !!
reviews.name: Jala Baranyai

reviews.text: Fiona and Simon were such a pleasure to deal with throughout. They were both professional and friendly and really made the whole process so simple and enjoyable for me. Thank you both very much! I would highly recommend!
reviews.name: Sheri Noad

reviews.text: Treveth Holdings have recently engaged with Girling Jones on a number of recruitment opportunities. They demonstrated a good understanding of our business and the candidate profile. Great communications and very professional. I would contact them first before anyone else.
reviews.name: Andy Mansell

reviews.text: Girling Jones have provided me with an excellent service and quickly found me position. Their communication is very good with quick response time and ongoing support. I have dealt with Michelle most of the time and she is very efficient and professional. Would recommend this agency.
reviews.name: Anne McLaren

reviews.text: We had the pleasure of working with Simon and the team at Girling Jones on a creative project earlier this year. Wow, what an inspiring and forward thinking environment they’ve built there. The team are genuinely driven and clearly very happy to be doing what they’re doing and I’m sure thriving as a result. This positive vibe can only be spreading out to their many lucky clients.
reviews.name: Sam Brown

reviews.text: While looking for a new position in Construction, I came across Girling Jones who were advertising the exact role I was looking for. During the entire process, Girling Jones was both very professional and personal and helped from Initial application through to receiving a contract. I can not recommend these highly enough.
reviews.name: Colin Alabaster

reviews.text: Outstanding amongst other employment/recruitment agencies. Excellent service and great communication.
reviews.name: Katarzyna Molenda

reviews.text: I would strongly recommend anyone to at least contact Girling Jones Ltd. They are very professional and incredibly supportive. It is a company who value you as you.
reviews.name: Simon Higgins

reviews.text: Experienced a very professional level of service, frequent follow up and advice readily given and provided; would recommend to others to use their service
reviews.name: Antony King

reviews.text: I have dealt with Girling Jones for over 4 years now, and as a client I can say the service provided is of high quality. Simon and the team are easy to speak with; not too corporate but very professional at the same time; and always personable. In being a client, it is good to know that GJ pride themselves on the quality of the service they provide, along with that competitive edge that makes them one of my top performing employment agencies.
reviews.name: Russell Smith

reviews.text: Very professional and responsive, could not have been more helpful throughout my time with them
reviews.name: Ben Bradshaw
